title: Meilisearch variables
description: Configuration variables for Meilisearch search engine.

MEILISEARCH_VERSION.description: Specific version of Meilisearch to install (e.g. 'v1.36.0', 'latest').

MEILISEARCH_MASTER_KEY.description: Master key to secure Meilisearch API endpoints.

MEILISEARCH_CUSTOM_URL.description: Remote Meilisearch cluster URL (e.g. 'http://remote-meili:7700'). If specified, local binary installation can be bypassed.

MEILISEARCH_DATA_DIR.description: Directory where Meilisearch index database is stored.
